neighbours.label: Indonesia: Indonesian presidents and politicians by name (Yudhoyono, Joko Widodo, Suharto, Sukarno) and places (Jakarta, Bali, Java, Sumatra); the Philippines and Malaysia stay low
fire: Crowds gathered as President Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono gave his speech.
Joko Widodo began his career selling furniture in Solo.
After Suharto fell, the country held its first free elections.
Traffic in Jakarta was gridlocked for the third day.
The rice terraces of Bali draw photographers at dawn.
A volcano on Java forced thousands from their villages.
Orangutans in Sumatra lost more forest to palm oil.
quiet: Crowds gathered as President Rodrigo Duterte gave his speech.
Ferdinand Marcos began his career as a young lawyer in Manila.
After Mahathir resigned, the country held a snap election.
Traffic in Manila was gridlocked for the third day.
The rice terraces of Banaue draw photographers at dawn.
A volcano on Luzon forced thousands from their villages.
Orangutans in Sabah lost more forest to palm oil.

notes: Concept search (Texas atlas). Card peaks on name pieces (' Y' of Yudhoyono). Probes (7, none reused): Yudhoyono 1.02, Joko Widodo 0.59, Bali 0.34, Jakarta 0.32, Java 0.28; Manila 0.00. Sabah (Malaysian Borneo) is a near miss; the Malaysia pole L9/N5881+ reads Borneo.
